data.name: Ecstatica
data.detailed_description:
SURVIVE TIRICH

The young Ecstatica lies in a deep, trance-like coma, and her disturbing dreams are wreaking havoc on the once peaceful village of Tirich. 

A solitary traveller has stumbled upon this deserted village, and what started as a simple quest for shelter turns into a horrific saga of death, torture and demonic possession. 

Help to free Ecstatica in this terrifying, graphic adventure with a fully explorable 3D environment, stunning animation, and unique ellipsoid technology graphics. So lock your doors and check under your bed. Ecstatica is a nightmare like none you've experienced before.

WHAT’S INSIDE THIS RELEASE

Originally released in 1994, Ecstatica is a cult survival-horror adventure by British developer Andrew Spencer Studios, published by Psygnosis. An early pioneer of the genre, it is famous for its one-of-a-kind "ellipsoid" graphics. This is the first time the game is available digitally.

The re-released version not only ensures that the game runs smoothly on modern systems, but also adds a number of improvements, including full controller support and the ability to switch between three graphics modes, from Classic DOS to Software mode with modern resolutions.

FEATURES

  • Three graphics modes: Classic DOS, Classic Windows and Software with modern resolutions

  • Full controller support

  • Unique and ground-breaking for its time, Ellipsoid technology creates a completely controllable character with smooth, fluid motion

  • Over 200 Beautifully animated sequences, detailed 3D backgrounds, cinematic cuts and perspective, making this game a truly interactive experience

  • Choice of a Male or Female main character

  • Unique immersive user interface

data.short_description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German
*languages with full audio support
